description:
intent=i039 snapshot=s10 branch=tasklet-napi-softirq-lock status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/ti/cpmac.c:715-722 confidence=medium conclusion=Cpmac priv->rx_lock is taken with plain spin_lock in the cpmac_hw_error workqueue worker (720) while NAPI cpmac_poll takes the same lock under NET_RX softirq (408), so a same-CPU softirq can spin forever against the preempted worker (soft-lockup DoS).
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/silan/sc92031.c:1081-1096 confidence=medium conclusion=sc92031_tx_timeout takes priv->lock with plain spin_lock (1088) while the ISR-scheduled RX/TX tasklet takes the same lock in softirq (841), so the missing spin_lock_bh lets the tasklet spin forever against the preempted timeout holder (soft-lockup DoS).
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath5k/base.c:1125 conclusion=Follow up: resolve whether ath5k_drain_tx_buffs' plain spin_lock(&ah->txbuflock) at 1125 can race a still-schedulable tasklet (ani_tasklet or cross-CPU rxtq/txtq) or another process-context plain acquirer of txbuflock/rxbuflock.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/chelsio/cxgb3/sge.c:2611 conclusion=Follow up: trace cxgb3 sge.c process-context callers of plain spin_lock(&q->lock) (restart/ctrl/cmd helpers around 1491-1785) and decide whether any runs BH-enabled alongside the NAPI poll's plain acquisition of the same queue lock.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/tundra/tsi108_eth.c:830 conclusion=Follow up: open tsi108_eth.c and classify its three plain spin_lock sites against its NAPI poll body to decide whether a process-context plain holder shares a lock with the NET_RX softirq side.
coverage_gap=Tasklet/NAPI lock correlation was done by textual lock-expression base name per file; locks reached via differently named pointers, container_of aliases, or per-queue lock arrays between softirq and process sites could not be matched automatically.
coverage_gap=Only the tasklet callback body plus the NAPI poll function and their same-file direct callees were treated as the softirq side; locks reached through deeper indirect calls (ops->, hw->, dmaops->, function-pointer tables, cross-file statics) were not resolved.
coverage_gap=NAPI poll registration was found via netif_napi_add/napi_schedule greps; polls registered in files where the schedule site lives elsewhere, and net core/protocol tasklet users (mac80211, can/bcm, dccp ccid2, tcp_output, iucv, rds), were not deep-read in this pass.
coverage_gap=Process-context sites that disable BH via local_bh_disable() nesting or via a spin_lock_bh on an outer lock around a plain inner acquisition were only manually resolved for the classified candidates; the full tree was not audited for that pattern.
